name: Goan Choriz Pao (Sausage Pao)
instructions: 1. Remove the casings from the Goan choriz sausages and set the meat aside. 2. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onions until translucent. 3. Add ginger-garlic paste, curry leaves, and green chilies, cooking until fragrant. 4. Add the choriz meat (and potatoes if using) to the pan, stirring well to break up any large chunks. 5. Cook on medium-low heat until the meat is browned and oil begins to separate, adding a splash of water if needed to create a thick gravy. 6. Slice the Pao halfway through, toast it lightly if desired, and stuff generously with the cooked sausage mixture.
description: Goan Choriz Pao is an iconic representation of Goa's Indo-Portuguese culinary heritage. The sausages are prepared by curing pork with feni (local spirit), vinegar, and a blend of intense spices like cinnamon, cloves, and chili. It is a beloved breakfast or evening snack synonymous with Goan comfort food.
